scenes.narration_text: Every scene in a documentary makes a promise: what you see and hear is backed by something real. So what has to be true before a scene is allowed in?
scenes.visual_strategy: Original typographic title card; slow hold.

scenes.purpose: Explain that claims are tracked separately from sources
scenes.narration_text: Here, a claim is tracked separately from its source. It stays unverified until a named person reviews it and records the date.

scenes.purpose: Show that every asset carries rights and a checksum
scenes.narration_text: Every visual carries its paperwork: who made it, under what licence, and a checksum that flags a changed file before it reaches a render.
scenes.visual_strategy: Original diagram of an asset record.

scenes.narration_text: And nothing publishes itself. A person approves the script, the visuals, and the final export.
scenes.visual_strategy: Original diagram of the approval gates; end on hold.
